title: Stanford CS224N: NLP with Deep Learning | Spring 2024 | Lecture 10 - Post-training by Archit Sharma
description:
For more information about Stanford's online Artificial Intelligence programs, visit: https://stanford.io/ai

This lecture covers:

2. Instruction fine-tuning

4. What’s next?
